column1: # The host's own answer for every class whose SDK 26.2 header closes -init and +new with
# NS_UNAVAILABLE, transcribed from probe.m's output on this machine and held to it by
# check_host.py, which fails when the host answers something else. own-init and own-new say
# whether the selector is in the CLASS's own method list, which is the corpus row's question
# and which an inherited selector is in no class's; answer/exception/reason say what a caller
# reaches at run time, which is the behaviour the port owes. port-source and port-object are
# where the port answers it and which of the two pair-macros it answers with, and
# check_port.py holds the source, the macro's own definition and the object to all three.
# A raise with an empty reason is Apple's own: measured, the exception carries a reason of
# zero length for the nine classes that name no other door. The reason field is empty there
# and the port raises with an empty format, which is the same exception a caller sees.
